name: Python with Ruff, pytest, and mypy
description: A Python application or library using Ruff, pytest, and mypy.

definitions.name: Purpose
definitions.defaultText: Build or maintain a Python application or library for the agreed user need. Define observable completion before editing.

definitions.name: Scope
definitions.defaultText: Change only the requested behavior and its needed tests. Preserve public interfaces and existing user work; ask before broad refactoring.

definitions.name: Architecture
definitions.defaultText: Keep domain logic separate from entry points and external services. Follow the existing package layout and pyproject.toml configuration.

definitions.name: Dependencies
definitions.defaultText: Use the existing dependency and lockfile workflow. Explain and agree on new runtime or development dependencies before adding them.

definitions.name: Quality
definitions.defaultText: Run ruff check, ruff format --check, and mypy on the configured project paths. Do not weaken rules to silence errors; if a tool is absent, report that before changing configuration.

definitions.name: Testing
definitions.defaultText: Add focused pytest cases for changed behavior and meaningful failure paths. Run the relevant tests, then the project test suite when appropriate.

definitions.name: Proof
definitions.defaultText: Report the focused diff, Ruff, mypy, and pytest results. Identify skipped checks and stop when the agreed behavior is verified.
